subject: general
question:
One of the four underlined words in the given sentence is incorrectly spelt. Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

Let us __appreciate__, support and__ contribute__ our might to the __promotional __efforts of the __comunity__.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'comunity'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'community'.**
 
• The word '**community**' is a **noun** which means 'a group of people living in the same place or having a particular characteristic in common'. **(समुदाय)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• We should always work towards the betterment of our community.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'comunity'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Appreciate -** recognize the full worth of something **(सराहना)**
 
• **Promotional - **related to the promotion of a product, service, or idea **(प्रोत्साहन से संबंधित)**
 
• **Contribute -** give something in order to help achieve or provide something **(योगदान देना)**
